text: h1「単語の出現頻度」。既存折返しで両幅に収め、省略・切取りなし
text_en: Static heading text wraps at both viewport widths without truncation.

text: metadata（ファイル名、総出現回数）。basename全文・空白を保持、元totalを全文表示し表より上
text_en: Static metadata text shows full basename and original total above the table, including long whitespace-sensitive text.

text: 順位・単語・回数の3列表。空入力・抽出0語・全除外で0データ行、閾値とtop後の共通pairsを表示
text_en: A static result table collection has zero, one or many rows after threshold and top filtering, with long word text and complete content only.

text: pairsが空の場合だけempty-message。既存固定文言を自然に折返し両幅で全文可読
text_en: Static empty message text wraps fully at both viewport widths.
